ta.explanation: கருப்பொருள் வரைபடம் ஆறுகள், நகரங்கள், அரசியல் பிரிவுகள், நெடுஞ்சாலைகள் போன்ற பொதுக் கூறுகளை மட்டும் காட்டுவதில்லை.

questions.quote: In 1854, John Snow, a doctor from London created the first thematic map used for problem analysis when he mapped cholera's spread throughout the city.

en.q: Who created the first thematic map used for problem analysis in 1854 by mapping the spread of cholera in London?
en.explanation: Thematic maps display density, distribution, relative magnitudes, gradients, spatial relationships and movements.

ta.q: 1854இல் லண்டனில் காலரா பரவலை வரைபடமாக்கி, சிக்கல் பகுப்பாய்வுக்கான முதல் கருப்பொருள் வரைபடத்தை உருவாக்கியவர்

questions.quote: They are choropleth map, isopleth map, proportional symbol map, dot map and chorochromatic map.

en.q: Which of the following is NOT one of the five types of thematic map named in the text?
en.explanation: The five types are choropleth, isopleth, proportional symbol, dot and chorochromatic maps.

ta.q: நூலில் குறிப்பிடப்பட்ட ஐந்து கருப்பொருள் வரைபட வகைகளில் ஒன்றல்லாதது எது?
ta.explanation: கோரோபிளத், ஐசோபிளத், விகிதாசாரக் குறியீடு, புள்ளி, கோரோகுரோமேடிக் வரைபடங்கள் ஐந்து வகைகள்.

questions.quote: The dot method is a convenient method of representing absolute numbers on maps. Each dot is assigned with a value and the number of dots, can be placed within an area as per their distribution pattern.

en.q: Which method is a convenient way of representing absolute numbers on maps, with each dot assigned a value?
en.explanation: Dot maps are drawn to show the distribution of population, cattle, area under crops and output of commodities.

questions.quote: The choropleth map uses shades or tints to show intensity or distribution of a particular element. It takes into account administrative units which form the basis of spatial distribution of data.

en.q: Which thematic map uses shades or tints, conforming to administrative units, to show the intensity or distribution of an element?
en.explanation: Light shading shows low density and dark shading shows high density.

en.explanation: They are used for density of population, literacy, growth rates, sex ratio and percentages.
